author: Hailer Oy
description: Customer dashboard — assets, support tickets, contacts, opportunities, ManikinPC, rentals, online orders, and trips/IHS visits, all in one place for any client.
versionDescription: Reworked the customer header layout: a map (no API key needed — Google's plain embed geocodes the address server-side) now sits on the left, client details on the right, tabs below. Falls back from full street address down to just the country if the address is incomplete, and shows a plain empty state if there's no address at all.
